resident - Keep a suite available to a monitor, running specifications when the 
monitor asks
└── Register a suite with a monitor and run the specifications it asks for
    └── dotnet run -- resident <hostpath>
        ├── [-u, --url <url>]
        ├── [-i, --id <id>]
        └── [-l, --list]

                                                                                
              Usage   Description                                               
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
           hostpath   The spec project's test host executable — the thing you   
                      would run to run the suite                                
           exitcode   ExitCode                                                  
  [-u, --url <url>]   Base URL of the monitor to register with; defaults to     
                      the one every publisher probes                            
    [-i, --id <id>]   A stable runner id. Defaults to BOBCAT_RUNNER_ID, then    
                      to a fresh GUID                                           
       [-l, --list]   List what the host specifies and exit, without            
                      registering with anything
